title: Measure the users_me_apikey Phase-0 arm on Linux (86p9 wired it, nothing drove it) - the whole eleven-endpoint set re-run

headline.what_this_closes: 86p9 wired users_me_apikey into the Phase-0 set and nothing had ever driven it. It now has a socket-mode campaign artefact with status_is_clean true, and the gate reports C1 PASS over eleven of eleven required endpoints.

users_me_apikey.p99_withheld_because: pooled n=500 is below the 10000 sample floor (ADR-0022 Rule 2); the harness states that itself in p99_note
users_me_apikey.budget_source: settings.rate_limit.API_KEY_LIMIT, added by g4my and pinned in EXPECTED_EIGHT; a difference between the live value and the pin voids the run

gate.c1: PASS - all 11 present, every one at concurrency 8
gate.c7_c8_c9_why_failed: no paired-arm, CPU-profile or event-loop-occupancy artefact was supplied, and the gate refuses to assume one. oxx2's acceptance names C1; these three are a different bead's work.

headline.why_previous_estimate_is_null: oxx2 had no estimate to check. 86p9 was closed wiring-only and stated no Linux number for this arm, on purpose; the round-trip and command counts for the API-key seam belong to M-7 and were not re-measured here.

harnesses: scripts/step4_campaign.py (three runs: group A, B, C) - in repo at the measured commit
scripts/step4_gate.py (the checker; it reads artefacts and never recomputes a statistic)
instrument.transport: real socket. uvicorn 127.0.0.1:8100, --loop auto --http auto (uvloop + httptools), started with no --loop/--http so both resolve by auto-selection, which is the configuration Dockerfile's CMD ships. Seeding is in-process over ASGITransport and is harness setup, not measured work.
instrument.what_is_counted_where: This re-run counts LATENCY only. Redis round trips and commands for the API-key seam are M-7's quantities, measured by a different instrument (scripts/e2e_apikey_endpoint_baseline.py) and recorded in perf-results/RESULT-20261017-m7/m7_apikey_endpoint_baseline.json. They are deliberately not restated here.

measured_tree.branch_state: detached worktree at /home/ansible/oxx2, created from a bundle; the Linux clone never fetched it from a remote and nothing was pushed
measured_tree.why_a_bundle: the commit was never pushed, and a thin bundle was refused with 'Repository lacks these prerequisite commits: 2fc6a7e7', so a full-history bundle carrying a temporary local branch (oxx2-measure) was used

host.virtualisation: VMware VM (systemd-detect-virt -> vmware, product 'VMware Virtual Platform')
host.deployment_recorded_by: PERF_ORCHESTRATOR=vmware-vm (assert_deployment_recorded aborts the run without it)

stores.locality: SAME 4-CORE VM as both the app and the load client. The manifest's store_locality says 'remote' only because the store addresses are IP literals rather than local sockets; do not read it as a split deployment.

declared_configuration.tier: Pro (the target's tier table holds 'Pro', capital P; 'pro' selects nothing)
declared_configuration.rbac_role: step4-full-access, 26 of 26 permissions granted to 64 users - a DECLARED CONFIGURATION, like the tier
declared_configuration.why_group_b_is_two: these four arms are charged an IP-keyed window - DEFAULT_ANONYMOUS_LIMIT (10, 3600) for users_me_anon and, for login and logout, that window PLUS SECURITY_BUDGETS['auth'] (5, 60). The BudgetGate holds every declared window at once, so five repetitions of ten requests would spend one hour of waiting per ten requests: roughly five hours per endpoint. Two per repetition is ten pooled requests, exactly what fills the window, which is also the pooled n v8qm reported for these arms.

api_key_credential.how_it_was_minted: out of band, by scripts run against the target's database, because the campaign has no minting step and the key must outlive the campaign's own seeding
api_key_credential.why_a_dedicated_account: seed_accounts runs DELETE FROM users WHERE username = $1 on every campaign invocation and api_keys.user_id is ON DELETE CASCADE, so a key owned by a seeded row would be deleted by the next campaign run that needs it
api_key_credential.tenant: system - the campaign sends X-Tenant-ID: system on every request, so a key in any other tenant answers API_KEY_TENANT_MISMATCH
api_key_credential.transport: X-API-Key plus a rotating X-Forwarded-For over the 16-address pool API_KEY_SOURCE_IPS (127.20.0.1 .. 127.20.0.16), which the app honours because the peer is loopback and therefore a trusted proxy
api_key_credential.live_check_before_the_campaign: curl with the key returned 200 with x-ratelimit-limit: 1000, period 3600, remaining 999 - i.e. g4my's API_KEY_LIMIT is in force on this target, not the anonymous 10 M-7 measured

results.no_unexpected_response_anywhere: status_is_clean true on all eleven, unexpected_statuses empty, unexpected_bodies empty (0 on every arm). users_me_anon returned only 401, which is its EXPECTED status, declared in the endpoint table before the run.
results.limits_in_force_throughout: every arm's declared rate budget was enforced by the harness pacer and none was relaxed. controls_unchanged true and control_differences_at_end [] on all three campaign artefacts; a difference would have voided the run.

gate.read_this_honestly: C1 is the criterion oxx2's acceptance names, and C1 PASSES over eleven of eleven. The run is reported as a whole-gate FAILURE rather than dressed up, because the checker is the authority and it declines to assume the three artefacts it was not given. C7/C8/C9 are separate pieces of work with their own scope.

comparison_to_v8qm.why: v8qm (FastAPI_saas-v8qm) is the closed ten-endpoint gate PASS this set replaces; its artefacts live only on the Linux target and were never committed, so C1 could not be assembled from the repo without a re-run.
comparison_to_v8qm.not_the_same_sample_size: users_me, users_list, users_search and health were driven at 10000 per repetition here (50000 pooled) against a pooled n of 10000 in v8qm
comparison_to_v8qm.verdict: NOT ATTRIBUTED. The p50s move in both directions and every published p99 except users_list and users_search is higher here. Three differences are live at once - a different commit, five times the pooled sample, and the same co-located 4-core VM - and this run measures none of them separately. [Inference] the larger, longer sustained load is the likeliest carrier of the higher tails, because a tail is what a five-times-longer steady pressure changes first; that is a hypothesis, not a finding. Calling any of it a regression needs a controlled A/B at one commit and one n, which this bead does not have and did not claim.

measured: all eleven endpoints' pooled n, concurrency, repetitions, the four per-repetition figures and the p50/p95/p99 the harness resolved, over a real socket
every response status, with the four IP-keyed arms' 401 and the body arms' 201 as declared expected statuses
the pacing record: which control bounded each arm and how long it waited
the eight rate-limit controls, asserted unchanged from the start of each run to its end
gate criteria 1-6 and 10, and the reasons 7-9 could not be met
the API-key budget in force on the target: x-ratelimit-limit 1000, period 3600
inferred: the cause of the tail difference against v8qm (three candidates, none isolated)
explicitly_not_measured: Redis round trips and commands for any arm in this re-run; M-7 owns those for the API-key seam and this run does not restate them
the CPU profile C8 asks for and the event-loop occupancy C9 asks for
the /health paired arm C7 asks for
any single-deployment latency claim: client, app, Postgres and Redis all shared one 4-core VM

limits: CO-LOCATED. The load client, uvicorn, Postgres and Redis all ran on one 4-core VMware VM. These latencies are a co-location figure, not a deployment figure, and must not be quoted as what a customer sees. They ARE comparable with v8qm, which used the same topology.
C7, C8 and C9 fail because their artefacts were not supplied. The gate refuses to assume one, and oxx2's acceptance names C1 only.
p99 is withheld on seven of eleven arms because their pooled n is below the 10000 sample floor. Only users_me, users_list, users_search and health published a p99.

users_me_apikey pooled n is 500. It is the honest maximum under API_KEY_LIMIT (1000, 3600) that fits in one run without the run itself becoming the load; at five repetitions of 100 the p50 is stable to four figures across repetitions but the tail is not resolvable.

The four IP-keyed arms were driven at two requests per repetition (pooled n=10, matching v8qm's n for those arms) because the (10, 3600) anonymous window costs an hour of waiting per ten requests. Their samples are small and their p99s are withheld for that reason.

The api-key arm rotates sixteen X-Forwarded-For addresses and therefore spreads across sixteen buckets of (1000, 3600) rather than filling one; the figure is per-source-IP admission cost, not the ceiling of a single source.
The API-key credential is a synthetic in-band key on a dedicated account. No claim is made here about how a real customer's key volume or source distribution would meter.

cross_reference.g4my: added settings.rate_limit.API_KEY_LIMIT = (1000, 3600) and rate_policy.build_api_key_rate_limit_key; live-checked on this target before the campaign (x-ratelimit-limit: 1000).
